Jon (Release): Heads-up — planning docs site cutover at 11:15 PT for the v2.3.1 release. Need SDK docs regen + changelog bump before cutoff. Is that window still OK? @Maria @Kevin @Alex
Maria (Docs): SGTM. I can run the site build and smoke tests. Can folks get PRs merged by 11:00 PT?
Kevin (SDK): Working on the SDK docs regen now, pushing a PR in a few. Will also do the package version bump to 2.3.1.
Alex (DevEx): I'll stand by for the final artifact publish and webhook to docs site. Ping me on the PR when it's ready.
Kevin (SDK): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/458 — includes docs regen plus changelog stub. Command I ran locally: ```make docs-regen && ./scripts/publish-sdks --version 2.3.1 --dry-run```
Sasha (Oncall): Reminder: branch cutoff is 11:05 PT. Anything landing after that should target main-post-cutoff unless it's a critical fix.
Maria (Docs): Copy. I'll start the staging build once Kevin's PR is merged.
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for docs-site at 1954323100 — https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/ (build 202)
Maria (Docs): Staging smoke done, most pages look good. Examples page renders at /console/examples. Staging link: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/v2.3.1/examples
Jon (Release): Sweet. Kevin, can you merge SDK PR by 11:00 so Maria can pull the artifacts?
Kevin (SDK): Merged at 1954323380. Tagging @Alex for publish.
Alex (DevEx): Starting SDK publish now. Will notify when artifacts are uploaded.
Alex (DevEx): SDK artifacts uploaded (s3://redwood-sdks/v2.3.1/) — triggering docsite webhook.
deploy-bot: production deploy for docs-site started at 1954324200 — rolling to CDN nodes
Maria (Docs): Production site is green for the key pages I asked to check. Quick changelog blurb I've added to the release notes: "v2.3.1 — console: improved batching config docs; SDKs: docs regen and minor API docs fixes."
Jon (Release): Great, cutover complete at 11:15 PT. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:
Sasha (Oncall): Noted. I'll watch monitoring for the next 30m and report any errors.
Kevin (SDK): Leaving a post-release note on the SDK repo about the version bump and a follow-up to check async examples.
Jon (Release): If anything odd shows up, open a new thread in #incidents and ping me. Otherwise I'll close this release window and follow up with a short rollout summary later.
Maria (Docs): Thanks — will add a quick checklist to the release notes about docs smoke steps so next time it's even faster. :white_check_mark:
